Program-list pages are repository/browse lists (Toledo business theses and dissertations 2004-2017; Warwick WRAP PhD theses for School of Industrial and Business Studies and a one-item Warwick Business School label), a Foster job-market page (2019, one Operations Management candidate) and a Foster blog post naming three Management and Organization doctoral students with dissertation titles (defense/proposal announcements, borderline event page). None of them state placements. The Toledo series label mixes theses and dissertations, so degree level per entry needs checking in the record pages. Institution by host kept as given for all pages; the Stirling pages are labeled 'University of Sterling' in the batch (the site spells it Stirling).
